title: A kept blog post takes its slug, a dropped tag page takes its tag off, and lat32 write and plan faults leave no false blocks
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A post one category below the blog item is renamed through its article with the router's id kept, and a rerun restores its demo alias; a dropped category view is skipped and a dropped tag page unpublishes its tag; hidden pagination and a dropped post's title leave with the dropped items; alt-only updates pass the look guard; phone and e-mail links printed from their words follow them; a picture-only list is not counted; credit links are hidden with their line; an unshared block decided in sharedBlocks moves to its page.

tests: a post one category below the blog item is ordered on its article, keeping the id the router prints
the stage renames the post through its article, and a rerun gives it back its demo alias, not its address part
a dropped category view is skipped though a kept post lives under it; a dropped tag page takes its tag off
a listing's pagination and a dropped post's title in a kept listing leave with the items the plan drops
a phone or e-mail link the template prints from its words follows them; the row's address slot is the title's
the look guard lets through an update that changes only the alts of pictures of a row read first
a credit link of the template is hidden with its hideable line; the business's own links stay as the plan kept them
a block the kit does not share, decided in sharedBlocks, moves to its one kept page, and leaves with a dropped one
a list of pictures and addresses has no words to be found by, so it is not measured, never "the page prints 2"
